questions.questionText: What does MPA stand for?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Multi-Page Application.

questions.questionText: In an MPA, what happens when a user submits a form?
options: Only a part of the page is replaced
The server responds with a new HTML file and the browser renders the page from scratch
The response is always JSON and no refresh occurs
questions.correctAnswer: The server responds with a new HTML file and the browser renders the page from scratch
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The server responds with a new HTML file and the browser renders the page from scratch.

questions.questionText: In an SPA, what does the server respond with for the initial request?
options: An index.html and a JavaScript file
questions.correctAnswer: An index.html and a JavaScript file
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) An index.html and a JavaScript file.

questions.questionText: In an SPA, in which format does the response usually come when a form is submitted?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) JSON.

questions.questionText: In an SPA, what is replaced when new data arrives?
options: Only the parts of the page that require change
questions.correctAnswer: Only the parts of the page that require change
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Only the parts of the page that require change.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an advantage of SPA?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) No full-page refresh.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is an advantage of SPA related to the Internet connection?
options: Offline functioning with previously visited pages
questions.correctAnswer: Offline functioning with previously visited pages
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Offline functioning with previously visited pages.

questions.questionText: Why do SPAs save bandwidth?
options: Only the parts that need to change are requested
They download the entire site each time
questions.correctAnswer: Only the parts that need to change are requested
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Only the parts that need to change are requested.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a drawback of SPA?
options: Full page reload on each click
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Complex development.

questions.questionText: Why does an SPA need additional Search Engine Optimization (SEO) care?
options: Search engine crawlers must execute JavaScript to index the app
questions.correctAnswer: Search engine crawlers must execute JavaScript to index the app
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Search engine crawlers must execute JavaScript to index the app.

questions.questionText: Why can an SPA have a slow initial load?
options: It downloads more resources when loading for the first time
questions.correctAnswer: It downloads more resources when loading for the first time
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) It downloads more resources when loading for the first time.

questions.questionText: If client-side JavaScript is disabled in the browser, an SPA will:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Not work.

questions.questionText: Which package is used to implement routing in ReactJS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) react-router-dom.

questions.questionText: Routing in an SPA refers to:
options: Changing the page in the SPA
questions.correctAnswer: Changing the page in the SPA
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Changing the page in the SPA.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is NOT an advantage of routing?
options: Pages can be protected behind a login form
It removes the need for components
questions.correctAnswer: It removes the need for components
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) It removes the need for components.

questions.questionText: Which command installs the React Router used in the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) npm install react-router-dom@6.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a basic component of the ReactJS Router?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Link.

questions.questionText: How many types of routers are in react-router-dom as discussed?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Two.

questions.questionText: Which are the two types of routers in react-router-dom?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) BrowserRouter and HashRouter.

questions.questionText: Which router is used with newer browsers?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) BrowserRouter.

questions.questionText: Which router is used with older browsers like Internet Explorer?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) HashRouter.

questions.questionText: Where is BrowserRouter wrapped around the App component in the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) index.js.

questions.questionText: Routing starts functioning only after:
options: BrowserRouter is imported and wrapped around the App component
questions.correctAnswer: BrowserRouter is imported and wrapped around the App component
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) BrowserRouter is imported and wrapped around the App component.

questions.questionText: Which component matches the URL with a given component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Route.

questions.questionText: In <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />, path="/" indicates:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The home page.

questions.questionText: In the session's routing, which component is displayed when the URL is /users?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) UserList.

questions.questionText: Which component should wrap multiple Route components in React Router v6?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Routes.

questions.questionText: Why was the Link component introduced?
options: Users cannot remember all URLs, and Link allows navigation through mouse click
questions.correctAnswer: Users cannot remember all URLs, and Link allows navigation through mouse click
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Users cannot remember all URLs, and Link allows navigation through mouse click.

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly creates a link to the users page?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) <Link to="/users">Users</Link>.

questions.questionText: Which prop of the Link component specifies the destination?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) to.

questions.questionText: What is the effect of using the Link component compared with the anchor tag <a>?
options: Link causes no page refresh while anchor causes a refresh
Link causes a refresh and anchor does not
questions.correctAnswer: Link causes no page refresh while anchor causes a refresh
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Link causes no page refresh while anchor causes a refresh.

questions.questionText: Anchor tag will not cause refresh. This statement is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) False.

questions.questionText: Which hook changes the URL programmatically?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) useNavigate.

questions.questionText: Which is a good use of useNavigate?
options: Navigating to a success or retry page automatically after payment
Extracting the id from the URL
questions.correctAnswer: Navigating to a success or retry page automatically after payment
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Navigating to a success or retry page automatically after payment.

questions.questionText: Which hook extracts the parameter from the URL?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) useParams.

questions.questionText: useParams is typically used to get what in an e-commerce product details page?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The id of the product.

questions.questionText: Which route path is used to match a dynamic user id?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) /users/:id.

questions.questionText: In path="/users/:id", what does ":" indicate?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The id is a variable.

questions.questionText: What does the useParams() hook return?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) An object.

questions.questionText: In const { id } = useParams(), what technique is used?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Destructuring.

questions.questionText: When the user visits /users/0, which user details are displayed in the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) The first user.

questions.questionText: How does the User card navigate to the details page on click?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) navigate(`/users/${id}`).

questions.questionText: Which path is used to match all paths when no other route matches, for a 404 page?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) path="*".

questions.questionText: Which component is used for redirection?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Navigate.

questions.questionText: Which prop is used with Navigate to replace the history entry during redirection?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) replace.

questions.questionText: Why is redirection used when a route changes from /people to /users?
options: So old users using old URLs remain unaffected
questions.correctAnswer: So old users using old URLs remain unaffected
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) So old users using old URLs remain unaffected.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about the Link component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) It causes no refresh.

questions.questionText: Does HashRouter work in old browsers?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Yes.

questions.questionText: Which statement about SPA and ReactJS is correct?
options: SPA is not possible with ReactJS
SPA is the same as MPA
SPA existed before ReactJS but was popularized by it
questions.correctAnswer: SPA existed before ReactJS but was popularized by it
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) SPA existed before ReactJS but was popularized by it.

questions.questionText: Which of the following describes the traditional Web app?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) MPA.

questions.questionText: Which hook-based approach is useful when styling must look like a button or a card and not like a Link?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) useNavigate.

questions.questionText: Which component renders only the UserList component and not Home for the URL /users?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Route with path="/users".
